verdict.rationale: Reclaim 2.0 documents a way to "preview changes in your calendar before deploying them," which gives a review step before automated scheduling changes take effect. Nothing in the evidence shows version history or rollback of automation settings. Missing for 10: versioning/history of automation configurations (Habits, Focus Time, priorities, buffer rules), rollback to a prior state, detailed docs on the preview/review flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
